hints.title: Triplet Block Parsing
hints.text: Numbers are naturally spoken in groups of three digits corresponding to Billion, Million, Thousand, and the remaining triplet.

hints.title: Sub-Thousand Recursive Helper
hints.text: Within each triplet below one thousand, handle hundreds, numbers between 10 and 19, and tens multiples recursively.

hints.title: Triplet Scale Concatenation
hints.text: Iterate through scales Billion, Million, Thousand. For each non-zero quotient, translate the 3-digit integer, append the scale, and join with single spaces.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.notes: Optimal solution achieving O(1) time and O(1) auxiliary space.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Attempting to handle special cases without modular triplet decomposition leads to nested string concatenation bugs.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Lookup tables for numbers below 20, tens, and thousand units require minimal static memory and evaluate in constant time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should handle zero, trailing whitespace, and boundary scales like exactly one thousand or one million cleanly.
